monitored_exceptions.entity_name: Indus Workforce Solutions Pvt Ltd (SP-001 — 38 Packing Workers Batch)
monitored_exceptions.rule_flag_reason: 38 full-time biscuit packing workers at Karachi Factory (Sindh) worked 26 standard days in October 2026 but were paid gross base monthly wage of PKR 32,000/worker—PKR 5,000/month below the Sindh Minimum Wage Notification floor of PKR 37,000/month (Total monthly underpayment = PKR 190,000).
monitored_exceptions.evidence_text: IR Audit Application Upload [SP-001 October 2026 Wage Sheet & ZKTeco Attendance Summary]: Workers EMP-C-1001 through EMP-C-1038 logged 26 full 8-hour shifts (208 hrs) at Port Qasim Biscuit Packing Line. Disbursed basic + statutory allowance = PKR 32,000/month per worker. Sindh Minimum Wages Act 2015 Gazette Notification mandates PKR 37,000/month.

monitored_exceptions.entity_name: Hattar Peak Labour Supply Agency (SP-006 — 24 Wafer Line Helpers)
monitored_exceptions.rule_flag_reason: 24 full-time wafer line helpers at Hattar Factory (KP) paid base monthly wage of PKR 31,000/month for 26 working days, violating the KP Minimum Wages Act 2013 notified floor of PKR 36,000/month (Shortfall = PKR 5,000/worker; Total = PKR 120,000). Contractor attempted to include 28 hours of overtime (PKR 5,500) to make gross pay appear as PKR 36,500.
monitored_exceptions.evidence_text: Contractor Wage Register SP-006 (Hattar Plant): Basic Wage column shows PKR 31,000 for 26 days + Overtime PKR 5,500 = Total PKR 36,500. Under KP Minimum Wages Act 2013 & KP Factories Act 2013 Sec 47, statutory minimum wage of PKR 36,000 applies to normal working hours (excluding overtime).

monitored_exceptions.entity_name: Sundar Estate Technical & Housekeeping Co (SP-015 — 19 Sanitation Workers)
monitored_exceptions.rule_flag_reason: 19 sanitation workers at Lahore Factory (Punjab) received net basic pay of PKR 33,500/month for 26 days after contractor deducted PKR 3,500/worker for 'uniform, boots & canteen tools', reducing wages below the Punjab Minimum Wage floor of PKR 37,000/month.
monitored_exceptions.evidence_text: SP-015 Payroll Sheet (Sundar Plant Lahore): Nominal Gross shown as PKR 37,000, less 'Contractor Uniform & Cleaning Kit Deduction' of PKR 3,500 = PKR 33,500 paid. Under Punjab Minimum Wages Ordinance 1961 & Payment of Wages Act 1936, deductions for employer-mandated PPE/tools that reduce wages below PKR 37,000 are unlawful.
